scripts.dev:gateway: npm run config:generate && wrangler dev --config wrangler.gateway.generated.json
scripts.test: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:console
scripts.test:console: npm run gateway:bundle && vitest run --config vitest.config.mts
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:console
scripts.build:gateway: npm run config:generate && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.gateway.generated.json --dry-run
scripts.build:console: npm run gateway:bundle && vite build && node scripts/sanitize-console-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run audit:public && npm run config:validate && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy:console: npm run verify:deployment && npm run build:console && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:gateway: npm run config:generate && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.gateway.generated.json

SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A 32-byte base64url key used to encrypt Cloudflare API tokens in console sessions.

CONSOLE_SESSIONS.description: KV namespace used for encrypted console sessions and deployment state.

PASSWORD.description: UGREEN remote-access password stored as a Worker secret.

UGLINK_CACHE.description: KV namespace used to cache short-lived UGREEN proxy sessions.
